text: After this you can screen speed-control savings without treating ideal ratios as guaranteed savings.

Fans and pumps use power to move air or fluid through a system. Their actual duty follows both equipment and system resistance. For the same machine in a similar operating region, ideal affinity relations estimate flow proportional to speed, head proportional to speed squared, and power proportional to speed cubed. Controls, minimum flow, changing efficiency, static pressure, and other system conditions can change the result. Verify required airflow or water flow before reducing speed.

items: Inferred: Illustrative estimate: If unchanged assumptions apply, reducing speed from 100% to 80% gives an ideal power ratio of 0.8 cubed, or 0.512. This is not a measured saving.
